name: Analytical RNA Secondary Structure Benchmark
description: A benchmark suite of RNA secondary structures designed to evaluate algorithms for the RNA inverse folding problem.
reputation: A niche, specialised benchmark used within the computational RNA design community but not widely adopted outside that field.
notes: Non-LLM / algorithmic benchmark; small and analytical dataset focused on designed structures; may not reflect full complexity of biological RNAs and has limited community-wide benchmark saturation.
